data.paraphrase: For every positive integer n, and for all distinct real numbers a and b, and for every function c from the finite set of size n to the real numbers, and for every matrix A of size n by n where the entry in row i and column j is a if i < j, b if i > j, and c_i if i = j, and for every polynomial p defined by p(x) = product of (c_i - x) for all i, the determinant of A is equal to (b * p(a) - a * p(b)) divided by (b - a).
